official_sources.evidence: Table 114 ordering information defines flash memory size code H as 1536 Kbytes for STM32F413xG/H.
STM32F423xH devices embed 1.5 Mbytes of Flash memory.
Official product page identifies STM32F423VH as Active and 1.5 MByte Flash; Q&R lists Active STM32F423VHH6 and STM32F423VHT6/VHT6TR.
Official product-line page states STM32F413/F423 devices carry 1024 to 1536 Kbytes of Flash memory.
